defect: The new desktop depth blit calls fbo_bind_for_read(currentRenderVfb_->fbo) without checking that the previous framebuffer has an FBO, so in non-buffered rendering (fbo set to 0, as the diff context shows) it dereferences a null FBO and crashes.
reason: The fix only adds the currentRenderVfb_->fbo != NULL check to the condition this change added.

defect: The fix only adds a hex rendering of the frame size to the Atrac tool's text output.
reason: This is a cosmetic display enhancement of a debug tool, not the repair of a defect.

defect: The change adds an '#ifdef USE_DIRECTX' before the NullGpu/SoftGpu includes with no matching #endif and an unguarded 'new DIRECTX9_GPU()' case, which breaks compilation (unterminated conditional, undefined type) on non-DirectX builds.
reason: The fix removes the stray #ifdef and wraps the GPU_DIRECTX9 case in #ifdef USE_DIRECTX, exactly the lines this change added.

defect: The fix turns mutexHeldLocks into a multimap so a thread can hold several mutexes, and rewrites the assert, erase and thread-end unlock logic accordingly.
reason: The one-mutex-per-thread map design and the assert's condition existed before; this buildfix only renamed threadID to thread and added the format argument.

defect: The fix initializes the previously uninitialized wantBG member in the GameInfo constructor.
reason: wantBG was already uninitialized before this change, which only added fileType to the initializer list.

defect: The fix converts the newly added Javadoc-style block comments to // line comments.
reason: Pure comment style change, no defect.

defect: The new log message calls t->GetTypeName() inside the branch taken when t == nullptr, dereferencing a null pointer when a handle slot is occupied but empty.
reason: The fix guards exactly that call with 't ? ... : null' in the line this change introduced.

defect: The fix adds casts on MemoryStick_SectorSize/FreeSpace results to silence 32-bit conversion warnings.
reason: Warning silencing without behavioural change; the real bugs in GetSpaceText (pointer arithmetic on string literals) are not touched.

defect: The change moves #include <signal.h> into the x86 branch, which uses asm int 3, leaving the non-x86 Crash() that uses kill(getpid(), SIGINT) without the header, breaking non-x86 non-Windows builds.
reason: The fix moves the include to the else branch where SIGINT and kill are used.

defect: In PerformReadback the change inserts the new mip arguments after the aspect (VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1) instead of before it, so the backbuffer transitions get aspect 0 and a wrong mip range.
reason: The other call sites in the same diff use (0, 1, aspect), and the fix reorders exactly these two calls.

defect: The fix changes the capitalization of the string 'JIT Using IR' to 'JIT using IR'.
reason: Cosmetic text change in moved code, no defect.

defect: The fix changes the capitalization of the menu label 'JIT Using IR'.
reason: Cosmetic string change; the label predates this change, which only renamed the second entry.

defect: The fix reworks the UWP text drawer for the new FontStyle/FontFamily API, loading bundled fonts from the VFS in memory and keying fonts by style.
reason: The UWP font loading broke through the later 'Font style rework: Windows part' (4283e66), which removed fontName and renamed the font files; this change kept the previous behaviour.

defect: The new code sets the sampler uniforms with glUniform1d (a double-precision setter) instead of glUniform1i, so the tex and pal samplers are never bound to units 0 and 1.
reason: The fix replaces exactly these two calls added by this change with glUniform1i (the multiplier tweaks are later tuning).

defect: skipWrap is initialized to true, so on the first line the next word is always treated as one character long and the first line never wraps correctly.
reason: The fix changes the initializer this change added from true to false, matching the resets to false elsewhere in the diff.

defect: The change implements the opcode at VFPU7 slot 24 as vrexp2 via a new Int_VRexp2, but that slot is vuc2i, so the instruction seen in Brave Story computes an exponential instead of a conversion.
reason: The fix removes Int_VRexp2, maps the slot to the new Int_Vx2i and moves vrexp2 to its real place (VV2Op case 28); seeing it needs MIPSTables.cpp and the VFPU encoding.

defect: In this file the fix only replaces the unused (indexLowerBound, indexUpperBound) parameter pair of TranslatePrim and the Translate* functions with a single indexOffset.
reason: The glitches the fix addresses come from TransformPipeline.cpp passing dc.prim instead of drawCalls[j].prim and advancing i wrongly; the IndexGenerator.cpp part is a parameter cleanup.

defect: The fix casts end to size_t in the comparison with maxPaste to silence a signed/unsigned warning.
reason: Warning silencing with no behavioural change.

defect: The fix changes the type of maxLen_ and SetMaxLen from int to size_t.
reason: Type change to fix conversion warnings, not a defect repair.

defect: memset(info, 0, sizeof(info)) on the array parameter float info[4] clears only sizeof(float*) bytes, leaving part of the output uninitialized.
reason: The fix replaces it with sizeof(float) * 4 in the line this change added.

defect: The new legacy_touch_mapping maps PAD_BUTTON_BACK instead of PAD_BUTTON_SELECT to CTRL_SELECT (the removed table used SELECT), and the touch buttons now go to fakeInputState so the onscreen unthrottle is no longer seen in input.pad_buttons.
reason: The fix restores PAD_BUTTON_SELECT and forwards fakeInputState.pad_buttons, repairing the touch buttons this change broke.

defect: The fix comments out the VPS touch button that replaced the turbo button when iFpsLimit is set, making the onscreen turbo a pure unthrottle.
reason: The author removes the feature because he no longer wants that behaviour, a design decision rather than the repair of a demonstrated defect in these lines.

defect: The fix adds a dirty flag for the index buffer and lets BindIndexBuffer accept nullptr so the software GPU can unbind its index buffer.
reason: The stale index-buffer binding comes from the later ApplyCurrentState code that applies nextIndexBuffer_ on every draw, and the nullptr call is added by the fix itself; this change never applied the index buffer.

defect: The fix rewrites (*errorMessage).clear() as errorMessage->clear().
reason: Pure syntax style change with identical behaviour.

defect: The new condition in GetCodesList is missing a closing parenthesis, so CwCheat.cpp does not compile.
reason: The fix adds the missing ')' to the line this change wrote.

defect: The fix extends the reversed joystick Y-axis menu navigation from Android to Linux.
reason: The non-Android path was unchanged by this change, so the upside-down navigation on Linux already existed before it.

defect: Clear() deletes every saveDataList[i].texture, including entries that share noSaveIcon->texture, and then deletes noSaveIcon->texture again, a double free when saving.
reason: The same diff guards the shared texture in SetFileInfo/ClearFileInfo but not in Clear(), and the fix adds that guard.

defect: The fix makes the memcpy replacement handle overlapping ranges in 16-byte blocks like the real PSP memcpy instead of using memmove.
reason: Using memmove for memcpy predates this change, which only switched to GetPointerUnchecked.

defect: ReplaceAll restarts its search at position 0 after every replacement, so it loops forever when dest contains src (e.g. replacing newline with CRLF).
reason: The function was moved verbatim from Common/StringUtils.cpp, where the same loop existed before this change.

defect: The new Win32 text drawer measures and draws with GetTextExtentPoint32 and ExtTextOut, which do not handle line breaks, so multi-line UI strings are measured and rendered as one line.
reason: The fix, the same day, replaces these calls with DrawTextExW on CRLF-converted text; seeing it needs knowing that callers pass strings with newlines.

defect: The fix casts table[block].size to size_t in a comparison to silence a sign-compare warning.
reason: Warning silencing without behavioural change.

defect: The fix casts streamMap.size() to int in isValidCurrentStreamNumber and adjusts other types to silence conversion warnings.
reason: currentStreamNum is checked >= 0 first, so the comparison was already correct; this is warning silencing.

defect: The new 'All supported file types' filter uses the pattern '*zip' instead of '*.zip', so it matches any name ending in 'zip' rather than .zip files.
reason: The fix corrects the typo in the filter string this change added; the impact is minor but the pattern is wrong.

defect: The fix removes the never-used member samplesLoaded_.
reason: Removing an unused field is cleanup, not a defect repair.

defect: The fix replaces the stepping logic in Stop/Reset/Cheats with Core_Stop or Core_WaitInactive to avoid deadlocks when a game hangs.
reason: The deadlock on a hung game comes from sending stop without stopping the core, which predates this change; its added un-stepping does not cause it.

defect: The fix removes the framebuffer refcount Release calls from the queue runner and drops refcounting in favour of another lifetime scheme.
reason: The leak this change introduced (Release only on transition) was fixed earlier by 63e78ef; the leak at fix time comes from the later empty-renderpass early return (ca3be18), and the fix is a redesign.

defect: The new Wipe() releases preTransitions, copy, blit and readback framebuffers but not step->render.framebuffer, which BindFramebufferAsRenderTarget AddRefs, so wiped render steps leak framebuffer references.
reason: The fix, prompted by a refcount leak, removes this incomplete release logic with the refcounting; seeing the imbalance needs the AddRef outside the diff.

defect: The fix adds an ignoreInput_ flag, set in TriggerFinish, so stray axis, key and touch events after finishing cannot trigger a second TriggerFinish.
reason: This change only dropped the bool return of axis(); axis events were forwarded to UI::AxisEvent before it in the same way.

defect: The fix removes the 'scale 1 on x and y means 2D' condition from Is2DVRObject.
reason: That condition (isOneScale) already existed before this change, which only restructured the checks into early returns.

defect: The new hard-coded Enter key is added to confirmKeys only if it is absent from cancelKeys (a copy-paste slip), so it is duplicated when already a confirm key and not added when it is a cancel key.
reason: The fix changes the search to confirmKeys in the line this change added, matching the cancel-key loop's pattern.
